mapper.sql: d.id, d.doc_no, d.kind, d.biz_type, d.io_category, d.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, d.to_warehouse_id, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, d.biz_date, d.status, d.total_qty, d.remark, d.source_no, d.in_transit, d.receive_by, ru.nickname AS receive_by_name, d.receive_date, d.receive_time, d.red_of, rd.doc_no AS red_of_no, d.reversed, d.partner_id, d.partner_name, d.flow_instance_id, d.dept_id, d.transfer_pricing, d.price_level, d.price_factor, d.cost_amount, d.transfer_amount, d.fee, d.fee_settle, d.fee_account_id, d.fee_carrier_id, d.fee_io_id, d.fee_bill_id, d.create_by, cu.nickname AS create_by_name, d.confirm_by, fu.nickname AS confirm_by_name, d.confirm_time, d.create_time, d.update_time

FROM wms_stock_doc d LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = d.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user cu ON cu.id = d.create_by LEFT JOIN sys_user fu ON fu.id = d.confirm_by LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON ru.id = d.receive_by LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc rd ON rd.id = d.red_of
mapper.select: SELECT wi.doc_id AS "docId", wi.warehouse_id AS "warehouseId", w.name AS "warehouseName" FROM wms_stock_doc_item wi LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = wi.warehouse_id WHERE wi.doc_id IN #{id} GROUP BY wi.doc_id, wi.warehouse_id, w.name

SELECT , fc.name AS fee_carrier_name, fa.name AS fee_account_name
LEFT JOIN scm_supplier fc ON fc.id = d.fee_carrier_id LEFT JOIN fin_account fa ON fa.id = d.fee_account_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT d.warehouse_id, w.name AS warehouse_name, d.to_warehouse_id, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, SUM(CASE WHEN d.red_of IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS doc_count, SUM(d.total_qty) AS total_qty, SUM(COALESCE(d.cost_amount, 0)) AS cost_amount, SUM(COALESCE(d.transfer_amount, 0)) AS transfer_amount, SUM(d.fee) AS fee FROM wms_stock_doc d LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = d.to_warehouse_id WHERE d.kind = 'TRANSFER' AND d.status IN ('TRANSIT', 'DONE') AND (d.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} OR d.to_warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId}) AND d.biz_date >= #{q.beginDate} AND d.biz_date <= #{q.endDate} GROUP BY d.warehouse_id, w.name, d.to_warehouse_id, tw.name ORDER BY w.name, tw.name
